description.value: The Northway Motor Inn is a 43-room motel in Dease Lake, BC, situated along the Stewart-Cassiar Highway (Hwy 37) — one of only two BC routes to the Yukon and Alaska — making it a critical overnight stop for anyone travelling this remote northern corridor. It serves as a base camp for exploring the Cassiar Mountains, historic Telegraph Creek, and the Stikine River wilderness. There is no cell service anywhere along Hwy 37 or in Dease Lake itself, making the inn's WiFi the sole connectivity lifeline for touring travellers in the area.

address.value: 81 Boulder Avenue, Dease Lake, BC V0C 1L0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity, contact, and location information. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific procedures, or cycling facilities appears anywhere on the site, so both required criteria are null. Laundry, WiFi, and a nearby grocery store are explicitly confirmed; the on-site pizzeria is noted as currently closed on the main amenities page.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both values sourced from website only
On-site pizzeria listed as 'currently closed' on the main amenities page; take-out restaurants in Dease Lake noted as seasonal hours only, limiting evening food reliability
No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) mentioned anywhere on the website
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate motel in a strategically important and very remote location on the Stewart-Cassiar Highway that touring cyclists would benefit from knowing about, but the website contains no evidence of bike storage, bike procedures, or any cycling-specific amenity required for confident WWC inclusion.

Laundry.detail: Guest laundry listed under hotel services (fees apply)

Wi-Fi.detail: High-speed WiFi listed as a standard room amenity; Info & Tips page notes it is the only connectivity option as there is no cell service in Dease Lake or along Hwy 37
